notes:
Pass on the fake backend only; evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. The package is model-authored (driver.lock.json authored_by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run retriage-drivers-1-026) and unreviewed (reviewed_by null); no hardware was attached and no hardware or sim backend was run.

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card proposes family-config/MujocoDriver, but the card's entry symbol is the repository's own MyoFullBody environment class (musclemimic/environments/humanoids/myofullbody.py:17), not a raw MJCF model. This clone ships no MJCF and the card's models list is empty; the environment resolves its model through the separate musclemimic_models package at runtime (myofullbody.py:449-453), and it exposes its spaces only through env.info (loco_mujoco/core/mujoco_base.py:158, :1296-1303), not as action_space/observation_space attributes. A MujocoDriver therefore has no model_path to load and a GymnasiumDriver cannot derive the spaces. The package is a direct Driver over the entry class with the package fake, as the object-with-methods shape in the authoring guide prescribes. It serves the card's first entry, MyoFullBody; the second entry, MyoBimanualArm, is a different device and is not served (one device per package). Bound classes: cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1.

CONTRACT: cap.world.step.v1 takes ticks and action {"values": [...]}, one normalized muscle command per actuator in the model's actuator order. action.values is bounded to [-1, 1] per element, the control range the environment sets on every muscle actuator (myofullbody.py:317-322; myofullbody.py:394-407 takes every actuator name). The vector length is model-dependent (the README lists 354 muscles with finger muscles disabled, README.md:48) and is deliberately not hard-coded; the native environment enforces the real dimension. cap.world.reset.v1 calls the native reset() and returns the initial observation. The native reset takes a JAX key, not an integer seed, so the class seed input is accepted but not applied and the output seed is 0; cap.world.seed.v1 is deliberately not bound. The environment returns (observation, reward, absorbing, done, info); the driver publishes absorbing as terminated and done-not-absorbing as truncated (mujoco_base.py:230-288, :397).

NOT COVERED: the fake backend is a pure Python stand-in. It models a tick, a placeholder excitation state and a placeholder eight-value observation row, accepts any non-empty action width, and returns no MuJoCo physics, muscle dynamics, contacts, tendons, sensors, reward or terminal handlers; it was never compared with the upstream environment. Every test-data number in fake.py is marked # placeholder. The real environment needs mujoco, jax, jaxlib, flax and the separate musclemimic_models package (pyproject.toml:34-40, :70) plus the model files, none of which is installed or present where the gate runs, so only the fake backend exists; no sim or hardware backend is declared. A live backend would need a deployment factory that constructs MyoFullBody() with those dependencies and the model, and would require deployment validation of the action width, observation composition, reward, termination and the 10 ms control step (0.002 s timestep times 5 substeps, myofullbody.py:56-57 and mujoco_base.py:1326-1333). No native stop exists: the device is simulated R0 and the e-stop is the runtime's software latch, which stops accepting step and reset and leaves the last observation and tick readable. No operator-required limit was needed, no site-limits.example.json is shipped, and no extension id was used, so there are no catalogue_requests.

The last gate run reported all gates G1-G9 pass with no warnings, no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. check-report.json is the gate's own report and is not part of the package; RESULT.json records the digest line the check printed.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Model review compared MyoFullBody and the unserved MyoBimanualArm entry, every citation, normalized bounds, stop latch, provenance and Apache-2.0 license with the pinned clone. Corrected driver.py to identify the deployed analytic fake as F0 rather than F1 MuJoCo, refuse missing/nonfinite native rewards and flags or malformed result shapes, and include the actual rescaling code in its control-function citation; test_driver.py covers the fidelity and invalid-return regressions. Updated facts.md and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. Fake G1-G9 and strict collection pass; a direct-driver/python-object override is proposed for the custom API whose external model is absent from the clone. For the human reviewer: Only the F0 fake is checked; actuator/observation dimensions and external musclemimic_models assets remain unvalidated. MyoBimanualArm is not served; the override scopes entry_symbols to MyoFullBody. No live backend or model load is included.
